rules.description: Only the bridge entrypoint and the funnel-owned deferred timer may start committed post-edit work.
rules.query: MATCH (caller)-[:CodeRelation {type:'CALLS'}]->(sink:Function {name:'processCommittedEdit'}) WHERE sink.filePath = 'webapp/js/compiled-edit-funnel.ts' AND NOT caller.filePath STARTS WITH 'webapp/tests/' RETURN caller.name AS caller_name, caller.filePath AS caller_path

rules.description: Only cloud, linked-window, and durable-outbox adapters may apply remote Yjs updates to the bridge.
rules.query: MATCH (caller)-[:CodeRelation {type:'CALLS'}]->(sink:Method {name:'applyRemoteUpdate'}) WHERE sink.filePath = 'webapp/js/patch-sync-engine.ts' AND NOT caller.filePath STARTS WITH 'webapp/tests/' RETURN caller.name AS caller_name, caller.filePath AS caller_path

rules.description: Steady-state Rust worker document updates enter through the bridge-owned forwarding boundary.
rules.query: MATCH (caller)-[:CodeRelation {type:'CALLS'}]->(sink:Method {name:'forwardWorkerYjsUpdate'}) WHERE sink.filePath = 'webapp/js/font-manager.ts' AND NOT caller.filePath STARTS WITH 'webapp/tests/' RETURN caller.name AS caller_name, caller.filePath AS caller_path

rules.description: Cached editing compilation is requested only through FontManager's queued policy-aware compile owner (compileEditingFont → compileEditingFontUnqueued).
rules.query: MATCH (caller)-[:CodeRelation {type:'CALLS'}]->(sink:Method {name:'compileEditingFromJsonCached'}) WHERE sink.filePath = 'webapp/js/font-compilation.ts' AND NOT caller.filePath STARTS WITH 'webapp/tests/' RETURN caller.name AS caller_name, caller.filePath AS caller_path

rules.description: Full binary compilation remains isolated to the explicit assistant analysis owner.
rules.query: MATCH (caller)-[:CodeRelation {type:'CALLS'}]->(sink:Method {name:'compileBinaryFont'}) WHERE sink.filePath = 'webapp/js/font-compilation.ts' AND NOT caller.filePath STARTS WITH 'webapp/tests/' RETURN caller.name AS caller_name, caller.filePath AS caller_path

rules.description: Whole-worker Y.Doc seeds are restricted to startup, linked-window bootstrap, cloud rebaseline, and explicit recovery.
rules.query: MATCH (caller)-[:CodeRelation {type:'CALLS'}]->(sink:Method {name:'seedWorkerYDocFromState'}) WHERE sink.filePath = 'webapp/js/font-compilation.ts' AND NOT caller.filePath STARTS WITH 'webapp/tests/' RETURN caller.name AS caller_name, caller.filePath AS caller_path

rules.description: Only reviewed forwarding and recovery owners may send raw incremental Yjs updates to the worker.
rules.query: MATCH (caller)-[:CodeRelation {type:'CALLS'}]->(sink:Method {name:'sendWorkerYjsUpdate'}) WHERE sink.filePath = 'webapp/js/font-manager.ts' AND NOT caller.filePath STARTS WITH 'webapp/tests/' RETURN caller.name AS caller_name, caller.filePath AS caller_path

sourceRules.description: Full-document worker requests are limited to reviewed bootstrap, rebaseline, and no-bridge source-reload owners; steady-state edits must use incremental Yjs updates.

callSiteRules.description: toCompileJSON is compile/preview/export only. A new production call is an unreviewed resting-model influx risk unless it is deliberately recorded here.

requiredCallRules.description: Layer JSON writeback into the model, Y.Doc, history, and storage must call the resting-layer codec so interpolator/compile payloads cannot enter as Shape.
